BiblicalUsage: Hazar-susah, the horse village, is listed among the cities allotted to Simeon in the far south of Judah. It is named once, in the allotment list, with no story of its own.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the allotment lists are promises kept in writing. Hazar-susah was given a name and a tribe, and that is the record of God's provision.
